hero.tagline: The sun is dead. Carry its last ember.
hero.pitch: Cross a dark land, build a champion from 64 relics, and pick your fights. Combat uses no dice: every foe carries gear you can read, and your Stone of Despair darkens before a fight that would kill you. When the Landlord comes for the rent at week's end, pay the tithe or fight for its head.

about.title: How it plays
about.intro: A run lasts three weeks. You step across a fogged map, open chests, visit shrines and forges, and piece together a relic build before the week runs out. Fights play out automatically; the strategy is in the route you take and the build you put together.

points.title: Read the foe, not the dice
points.text: Combat is 100% deterministic, and every foe carries real items you can inspect before the fight: judge its gear against yours. Your Stone of Despair marks any foe whose fight would kill you, and says nothing more. Against the Landlord it stays silent.

points.title: Pay the rent or fight
points.text: At the end of each week, the region's Landlord comes to collect. Pay the tithe from your purse to walk away alive, or fight it for its bounty. Win, and you can either bank your gold and go home or risk the whole purse in the next week.

points.title: The last night's hunt
points.text: On the final night of the week, the moon turns red and the Landlord steps onto the map to hunt you with every move. If your build is ready early, you don't have to wait: march to its throne and beat it for 50% more gold.

points.title: Your dead stay on the road
points.text: When a champion dies, it lingers in that land on future runs with the gear it carried. It wanders by day and hunts you at night. Kill it to recover part of the lost purse.

points.title: Your winners become Landlords
points.text: Champions who survive all three weeks are crowned. In later runs, they can take a region's throne and come to collect using the exact build that won.

story.title: The story
paragraphs: The Church parceled out the hours of daylight and sold them as deeds. The buyers became the Landlords, and they drained more light than the sun had to give. On the Last Morning, the sun fell.

Mother Hesper went blind watching it fall, caught its last ember in her apron, and lit the fire of the Last Camp. She plants a wick in each champion's chest and sends them east toward the Gate. A wick burns for three weeks.
Gold is cold sunlight, the only warmth left. Every week the moon seals the sky in red wax and the Landlords come for the rent. Those who die on the road keep walking until their debt is paid.
story.question: No one has carried the flame past the Gate. What waits on the other side?

features.title: Features
items: 6 playable champions, each with a unique starting weapon and passive.
64 relics across 8 families, with set bonuses at 2, 4, and 6 pieces.
77 enemies on the map, including patrols, ambushes, packs, guardians, and mimics.
Day and night cycle: at night your sight shrinks and shadows hunt you.
Dread: every kill makes the region deadlier and raises enemy gold drops.
Separate bank and purse: stake gold at the start and cash out after each Landlord.
9 optional oaths that raise both the difficulty and the payout.
17 blessings, 8 belt consumables, 12 road events, forges, campfires, and wells.
Past runs leave Echoes, risen champions, and crowned Landlords on your map.
Native 640x360 pixel art with mouse, keyboard, and touch controls.

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.intro: In development for PC and mobile. The Android closed beta is open now.
platforms.pcNote: Windows on Steam. The free demo also runs on macOS and Linux.
platforms.androidNote: Phones and tablets, on Google Play.

demo.title: Download the demo
demo.intro: A free demo for Windows, macOS and Linux. It plays the whole run, with fewer champions and relics to choose from.
includes: 2 champions: the Ironbound Penitent and the Gallows Marksman.
The full run: three weeks on the map, events, shops, oaths and the Landlords.
No Reliquary: the other champions, relic families and purse upgrades come with the full game.
Its own save, separate from the full game.
demo.windowsNote: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. One .exe file, no installer. The file is not code-signed yet, so SmartScreen may warn you: click More info, then Run anyway.
demo.macosNote: One app for Apple silicon and Intel Macs. Unzip it and drag Dawnbringer to Applications.
demo.macosOpen: The app is not notarized by Apple yet, so macOS blocks the first launch. Right-click (or Control-click) the app and choose Open. If there is no Open button, go to System Settings > Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway.
demo.linuxNote: x86_64. Extract the archive and run DawnbringerDemo.x86_64. Needs graphics drivers with OpenGL 3.3.
demo.android: Android: the closed beta is open.
demo.ios: iPhone and iPad: not available yet.

beta.title: Join the beta
beta.testCardCaption: Annotated Android test payment screenshot. The X crosses out the simulated amount. Green outlines mark the test card and Google's notice: this is a test order, you will not be charged.
beta.paymentNoticeTitle: The test payment amount is NOT REAL. You WILL NOT BE CHARGED.
beta.paymentNoticeText: With Test card, always approves, Google Play only simulates a purchase. Even if R$9.99 or another amount appears, no money is taken. Check that this is the selected payment method. If your personal card or another real payment method appears, do not confirm and contact us.
beta.intro: Play the Android version for free before launch.
beta.step1: Open Dawnbringer Testers and click Join group. Sign in with the Google account you use in the Play Store on Android. Opening the group is not enough: confirm that you have joined.
beta.step2: With that same account, open the test page and click Become a tester. Wait for confirmation that you have joined the test before continuing.
beta.step3: On your Android phone or tablet, open the game on Google Play and tap Install. On a computer, select your Android device in the dialog and click Install.
beta.note: Free beta access ends at launch. Joining the test does not include a purchase of the final game.
beta.accountHelp: Use the same account for all three steps: the group, the test page, and the Play Store. If you have several Google accounts, check the profile picture on each page and in the store app.
beta.priceTitle: Seeing a price or a Buy button?
beta.priceHelp: The listing can show a price even for a tester. Complete steps 1 and 2 first. On a computer, click Buy to open the device selection dialog. If it offers Install, select your Android device and click that button, as shown below. If a payment screen appears, read the test card instructions before confirming.
beta.storeCaption: On a computer, Google Play may show R$9.99 and Buy even during the test.
beta.installCaption: The next dialog may offer Install. Select your Android device to send the installation.
beta.paymentTitle: What is Test card, always approves?
beta.paymentHelp: It is Google Play's test payment card. If the payment method says Test card, always approves, confirming makes a simulated purchase with no real charge. If you see your own card or another real payment method, do not confirm. Check the account used in all three steps and contact us if the problem continues.
beta.unavailableTitle: Can't find the game or join the test?
beta.unavailableHelp: Check that you joined the group and opted into the test with your Play Store account. Wait a few minutes and reopen the test page. If you still cannot get access, send a screenshot of the message, without payment details, to

press.description: Dawnbringer is a dark-fantasy roguelike auto-battler in pixel art. The sun is dead, gold is the only warmth left, and every week a Landlord comes for the rent. Players explore a turn-based map, pick fights, and build a champion from 64 relics across eight families. Combat resolves automatically without RNG and every foe carries visible items, so players judge each road fight by reading its gear against their build; a Stone of Despair only warns when a fight would kill the hero. Against the Landlord it stays silent, and you must either pay the tithe or fight. Before each run you stake gold from your bank, and after each week you either cash out your purse or risk it in a harder week. Fallen champions roam the map in future runs, while victorious champions can return on a Landlord's throne.
